_comment: Shared Go/JS table of the groups a match write is merged by (bc-mrgc). Go half: TestMatchGroups_SharedTable (internal/state/match_groups_table_test.go) against state.ScalarGroups (repPickA and repPickB: each side's representative of the representative bout, a change of its own, dated apart from the other side's and from bout:-1), BoutGroup, ParseBoutGroup and ValidGroup. JS half: web-mobile/js/__tests__/match_groups_table.test.jsx against match_groups.jsx's SCALAR_GROUPS, boutGroup, parseBoutGroup and isValidGroup. A client write names its groups by these exact strings in `changed`, and the server refuses a name it does not know, so the two lists must never drift.
